steps.code:
# Fetch all habit log notes and extract ate_homemade_meals status
habit_data = []
for note in habit_notes:
    note_detail = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note["note_id"], access_token=access_token)
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Log -- YYYY-MM-DD"
    date_str = note_detail["title"].split("--")[1].strip()
    # Parse content for ate_homemade_meals
    content = note_detail["content"]
    # Find line starting with "ate_homemade_meals:"
    for line in content.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("ate_homemade_meals:"):
            value = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip().lower()
            habit_data.append({"date": date_str, "ate": value == "yes"})
            break
    else:
        habit_data.append({"date": date_str, "ate": False})

print(habit_data)
